name: Gorham-Stout Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Heffez et al. Diagnostic Criteria for Gorham-Stout Disease

criteria.description: Progressive osteolysis with radiographic evidence of bone disappearance
Biopsy showing angiomatous or lymphangiomatous proliferation within bone
Exclusion of other causes of osteolysis such as infection, malignancy, or hereditary bone diseases
Non-malignant clinical course with absence of visceral involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive osteolysis with histopathologic confirmation and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical and radiologic supported by histopathology; no specific laboratory test is diagnostic.

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic disappearance of bone on imaging

searchTerms: too many lymph vessels inside bone

common.symptomName: Reduced range of motion in adjacent joints

occasional.symptomName: Chylothorax due to thoracic duct involvement
searchTerms: fluid buildup in chest from lymph leak

occasional.symptomName: Muscle weakness adjacent to affected bone

rare.symptomName: Neurological deficits due to spinal involvement
rare.notes: Compression of spinal cord or nerve roots

searchTerms: fluid around lungs not from lymph

laboratory: Typically normal serum calcium and alkaline phosphatase
Possible mild anemia or elevated inflammatory markers in some cases
imaging: Progressive osteolysis on X-ray and CT
MRI showing soft tissue involvement and lymphatic proliferation
Bone scintigraphy with increased uptake in early stages
genetic: No known consistent genetic mutations identified
other: Histopathology demonstrating non-malignant vascular or lymphatic proliferation within bone

distinguishingFeatures: Different radiographic pattern with mixed lytic and sclerotic lesions

redFlags: Development of chylothorax causing respiratory compromise
Neurological deficits indicating spinal cord or nerve root compression
references: Heffez L, et al. 'Gorham's disease: the disappearing bone disease.' Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol. 1983.
Dellinger MT, et al. 'Gorham-Stout disease: a case report and review of the literature.' J Bone Joint Surg Am. 2014.
Radhakrishnan K, et al. 'Gorham-Stout syndrome: a review of literature.' Clin Rheumatol. 2017.
